sloka: न हि प्रेषयिता तात स्वामी प्रेष्यः कथंचन ।भवता अयम् जनः सर्वः प्रेष्यः प्लवग सत्तम ॥४-६५-२२॥
transliteration: na hi preṣayitā tāta svāmī preṣyaḥ kathaṁcana ।bhavatā ayam janaḥ sarvaḥ preṣyaḥ plavaga sattama ॥4-65-22॥

translations.english: Dear one, one who issues orders is a master and is never himself the one sent; best of monkeys, this whole assembly is yours to dispatch.
